_about: Latest capex guidance per company, as stated by management. Each entry hand-verified against the cited page. Update after each earnings call.

MSFT.text: FQ1 FY27 call: Q2 FY27 capex expected to be over $50B; calendar-2026 capex approximately $170B (lowered due to third-party capacity delays), with capex accelerating in H2 FY27 driven by CPUs/GPUs, higher memory and storage costs, and shifted 3P capacity deliveries.
MSFT.source: Microsoft Investor Relations (FY27 Q1 earnings call)

GOOGL.text: Q3 2026: Alphabet held 2026 capex guidance unchanged at $195B-$205B; CFO Anat Ashkenazi: 'We continue to expect our capex to increase significantly in 2027, and will provide further details on our Q4 call.'

AMZN.text: Q3 2026 release: 'We continue to expect 2026 cash capital expenditures to be approximately $220 billion.' No numeric 2027 guidance in the release.

META.text: Q3 2026 release: 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, expected in the range of $135-145B, narrowed from prior $130-145B; no 2027 capex figure given.

ORCL.text: Q1 FY27 call: CFO Hilary Maxson: 'We continue to anticipate $90 billion to $95 billion in CapEx for the full year ... with not more than $70 billion in net cash CapEx.'
ORCL.source: The Motley Fool (Oracle Q1 FY2027 earnings call transcript)

CRWV.text: Q3 2026: 'We now expect full year 2026 capital expenditures of $37 billion to $39 billion' (low end raised from $35B); CFO said on committed backlog alone 2027 capex would remain in line with 2026.
CRWV.source: CoreWeave Q3 2026 earnings press release (SEC Form 8-K exhibit); 2027 comment per CNBC
